title: USF Audit Event Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for audit event definitions (audit events, security-sensitive audits, state-changing audits, accountability records). Each declares its kind (audit-event-kinds), actor, action, subject, timestamp semantics, and security-sensitivity / state-change classification, mapped to the interface/workflow/semantic contract it accompanies. Every mutating or privileged action MUST have a defined audit semantic; audit coverage MUST NOT be removed as an incidental refactor. Governs the ontology concept Audit Event. lifecycleState draft; not active.
